summary: Go-live manual test pack for the Saranam India Health Care Scheduling module covering the weekly schedule lifecycle (draft -> submitted -> approved/communicated -> in_progress -> review_ready -> archived), weekly planning board with drag-and-drop visit assignment, route maps, vehicles/clusters/config settings, kit readiness, deviations, on-call roster, audit log, alerts, and the clinician My Visits / Today screens. Every screen, control, dialog, filter, map element and backend API call derived from the code is exercised, including validations, negative paths, empty/loading states, permissions/session and cross-module data integrity.
in_scope: Schedule Calendar list view with status tabs (All/Draft/Submitted/Active/Archived) and ?status=pending deep link
New Schedule and Quick Create flows + delete schedule
Weekly Planning Board: patient pool sidebar, day columns, Add Patient modal, drag-and-drop move/reorder, route optimize, smart suggestions, team assignments, view toggles, route map
Schedule lifecycle state transitions: submit / approve / send-back / activate / end-week-review / complete-review
Validation on submit (warnings), capacity, time conflicts, travel warnings
Schedule Settings: visit days, planning/approval deadlines, vehicle CRUD + add-hospital, cluster config
Active Schedule Visits: per-day visit tracking (complete/missed/cancel), deviation reporting, route map, team & route segments
Kit Readiness per-day checklist, Deviation Report, Review Dashboard metrics, Audit Log, On-Call Roster CRUD, Unscheduled Alerts
ScheduleDayMap rendering (markers, routes, hospital pins, zone overlay)
All scheduling/* and visit API calls, auth/401 refresh handling
out_of_scope: Patient registration, demographics and UHID generation (covered by Patients module)
Clinical assessment forms / AI summaries opened via Start Visit (covered by Visits module)
Inventory, IPD/OPD, teleconsult, physiotherapy, homecare modules
SMS/WhatsApp/email gateway delivery internals (only that approve triggers notification calls is verified)
Backend route-optimization algorithm correctness beyond observable UI behaviour
Zone wedge / pin-code mapping accuracy (pending client data per project memory)
roles_and_access: All scheduling routes are nested under <ProtectedRoute><DashboardLayout/></ProtectedRoute> in App.jsx with NO per-route requiredRole/requiredPermission attribute. Therefore any authenticated user (valid access_token in localStorage) can open every scheduling screen and call every scheduling endpoint; an unauthenticated user is redirected to /login by ProtectedRoute. There is no UI-level approver/planner role separation - the same user can submit AND approve a schedule (governance is by convention, not enforced). Every backend endpoint is decorated @jwt_required(); a missing/expired token returns 401 and the axios interceptor attempts a refresh, falling back to redirect to /login on failure. Note for testers: confirm with the client whether self-approval (planner approving own submission) should be blocked - currently it is allowed.

Get unread notification count

Create on-call roster entry

test_data_setup: Valid login credentials for an authenticated Saranam user (token stored in localStorage as access_token + refresh_token)
At least one Vehicle configured in Settings (e.g. 'Saranam Van 1', reg KA-01-AB-1234, base hospital KMIO) - required to create any schedule
A second Vehicle (e.g. 'Saranam Van 2', base KCGH) to test multi-vehicle grouping, suggestions and map colours

20+ patients in the pool with mix of: BSC/non-BSC, Onco/Non-Onco, with GPS lat/lng, with address-only (no GPS), is_new=true, days_since_last_visit values 0/22/35 (for approaching/overdue badges), geographic_cluster set to North/South/East/West/Central
At least one patient with NO GPS and NO address (to test map 'without location & address' state)
Several providers/clinicians with specializations Physician, Nursing, Counselor, Physiotherapy, Driver
One DRAFT schedule (with days/slots) for board, submit, delete, audit tests
One SUBMITTED schedule for approve/send-back tests
One COMMUNICATED schedule for Activate test
One IN_PROGRESS / active schedule with slots for Active Visits, kit, deviation tests
One REVIEW_READY schedule for Review Dashboard / complete-review test
Known invalid scheduleId GUID (e.g. 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000) and a malformed non-GUID id for negative URL tests
Test dates around June 2026 (week start Mon 2026-06-01, 2026-06-08); a past week (2026-05-04) for past-scheduling test
VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY configured so ScheduleDayMap renders (else map shows loading/blank)

test_cases.title: Calendar page loads with header, tabs and schedule list

Wait for the spinner to finish

Five status tabs (All, Draft, Submitted, Active, Archived) each show a count badge. The schedule table lists Week, Status, Patients, Days, Actions columns sorted newest week first.

test_cases.expected_result: Draft tab shows only status=draft; Submitted only submitted; Active shows approved/communicated/in_progress/review_ready; Archived only archived; All shows everything. Counts in tab badges match the rows shown.

test_cases.title: Report Deviation (emergency patient) captures emergency fields
steps: Open Report Deviation, choose 'Emergency Patient Visited'
Fill emergency name/location/reason + description
Submit
test_cases.expected_result: Emergency-specific fields appear when type=emergency_patient; deviation persists with emergency name/location and is displayed in the day's deviation list.

test_cases.title: Team and route segments panels render
test_cases.preconditions: Active schedule day with team assignments and GPS patients.
steps: Select a day with a team and routed patients
test_cases.expected_result: A 'Team for <day>' panel lists roles + provider names; a 'Route Segments' panel lists from->to legs with km and a total; numbered markers/route render on the map.

test_cases.title: My Visits loads the logged-in clinician's week grouped by day
test_cases.preconditions: Logged-in clinician is assigned to an approved/active schedule this week.
steps: Navigate to /saranam/scheduling/my-visits
test_cases.expected_result: Shows 'My Visits', week label, day accordions (expanded by default) each listing the clinician's patients with UHID, cluster, address, phone, Navigate and Start Visit actions.

test_cases.title: Acknowledge schedule banner
steps: On My Visits click 'Acknowledge'
test_cases.expected_result: Acknowledge button shows a spinner then the warning banner disappears (acknowledged=true). On error 'Failed to acknowledge schedule' is shown.

test_cases.title: My Visits empty / no-schedule state (404 handled)
test_cases.preconditions: Clinician has no schedule for this week.
steps: Open /saranam/scheduling/my-visits
test_cases.expected_result: A 404 from my-schedule is treated as 'no schedule' (not an error): shows 'No schedule assigned for this week' empty state.

test_cases.title: Navigate link + tel link + Start Visit navigation
test_cases.preconditions: My Visits with a patient having address and phone.
steps: Click Navigate (opens Google Maps in new tab)
Click the phone link
Click Start Visit
test_cases.expected_result: Navigate opens maps.google.com search for the address in a new tab; phone uses tel:; Start Visit routes to /saranam/patients/{patientId}/visit.

test_cases.title: My Visits load failure shows retry
steps: Open My Visits with the API returning 500
test_cases.expected_result: An error Alert 'Failed to load your schedule' with a Retry action button is shown.

test_cases.title: Today's Visits loads with completed counter
test_cases.preconditions: Clinician has visits scheduled for today.
steps: Navigate to /saranam/scheduling/my-visits/today
test_cases.expected_result: Shows 'Today's Visits', today's date, an 'X of Y completed' chip, and visit cards with status icon, BSC/Onco/Ad-hoc chips, cluster, address, phone and status-appropriate actions.

test_cases.title: Start -> Complete -> View flow on a visit
steps: Click Start Visit (scheduled->in_progress)
Click Mark Completed (in_progress->completed)
Click View Assessment
test_cases.expected_result: Status transitions optimistically per click; completed shows a View Assessment button linking to /saranam/patients/{patientId}/visit; completed counter increments.

test_cases.title: Mark Missed dialog with 'Other' free text
steps: Click Mark Missed
Select 'Other', enter details
Confirm Missed
test_cases.expected_result: Confirm disabled until a reason is chosen; with 'Other' the free-text is appended ('Other: ...'); slot becomes missed with that reason.

test_cases.title: Today's Visits empty state (no visits / 404)
steps: Open Today's Visits
test_cases.expected_result: Shows 'No visits scheduled for today' empty state; a 404 is handled gracefully as empty, not an error.

test_cases.title: Kit Readiness loads days with ready counter
steps: Navigate to /saranam/scheduling/kit/:scheduleId
test_cases.expected_result: Header 'Kit Readiness', an 'X/Y days ready' badge (green when all ready else orange), day tabs each with check/warning icon, and the selected day's patient table (#, name, BSC/Active + Onco/Non-Onco, notes).

test_cases.title: Mark Kit Ready for a day
test_cases.preconditions: Kit page on a day with kit_ready=false.
steps: Click 'Mark Kit Ready'
test_cases.expected_result: Button shows 'Marking...', the day becomes Kit Ready (green badge + 'Marked ready at' timestamp), the X/Y counter updates, and the day tab shows a green check.

test_cases.title: Kit Readiness empty / no-days and back link
test_cases.preconditions: A schedule with no days, plus any schedule.
steps: Open kit page for a schedule with no days
Click 'Back to Schedule'
test_cases.expected_result: Shows 'No days found in this schedule' card. Back to Schedule navigates to /saranam/scheduling/{scheduleId} (note: this path has no route - verify it 404s/redirects, log as a defect if broken).

test_cases.title: Deviation Report shows summary cards, compliance and per-day table
test_cases.preconditions: A schedule with completed/missed/cancelled/adhoc slots and deviations.
steps: Navigate to /saranam/scheduling/deviation-report/:scheduleId
test_cases.expected_result: Summary cards (Total, On Time, Late, Missed, Cancelled, Ad-hoc), a Compliance Rate bar (colour by threshold), a 'Reported Deviations' list, and a Daily Breakdown table with Patient/Scheduled/Actual/Status/Reason per slot.

test_cases.title: Deviation Report load failure and not-found
steps: Open deviation-report with a bad scheduleId or failing API
test_cases.expected_result: On failure shows 'Failed to load report data' Alert; if schedule null shows 'Schedule not found' info Alert; no crash.

test_cases.title: Compliance rate computation (late > 30 min) reflected
test_cases.preconditions: Completed slots with started_at >30 min after scheduled_time.
steps: Open the report and compare Late count vs On Time and Compliance %
test_cases.expected_result: Visits started >30 min late count as Late; On Time = completed - late; Compliance% = round(onTime/total*100). Bar colour: green >=80, amber >=50, red below.

test_cases.title: Review Dashboard shows metric cards and day breakdown
steps: Navigate to /saranam/scheduling/review-dashboard/:scheduleId
test_cases.expected_result: Header 'Weekly Review' + week label; metric cards (Completion Rate, BSC Coverage, Cluster Efficiency, Missed Visits) coloured by target (Missed inverts: lower is better); Day Breakdown table; Missed Visit Details when present; Review Notes textarea.

test_cases.title: Complete Review & Archive
test_cases.preconditions: Review Dashboard open for a review_ready schedule.
steps: Enter review notes
Click 'Complete Review & Archive'
test_cases.test_data: Notes 'Good week, 2 misses due to travel'
test_cases.expected_result: Button shows spinner; on success a 'Review Complete' confirmation screen replaces the page and the schedule moves to archived. Status now shows under the Archived tab on the calendar.

test_cases.title: Review load failure shows retry
steps: Open review-dashboard with the API failing
test_cases.expected_result: Error Alert 'Failed to load review data' with Retry; metric cards show '--' for null values.

test_cases.title: Audit Log lists entries with timestamp, action, actor, details
test_cases.preconditions: A schedule with audit activity (slot add/move/remove, submit, approve).
steps: Navigate to /saranam/scheduling/audit/:scheduleId
test_cases.expected_result: Table shows Timestamp, colour-coded Action badge, Actor and a Details summary; clicking a row expands a JSON detail block. Pagination appears when > 20 entries.

test_cases.title: Audit Log action filter
test_cases.preconditions: Audit log with multiple action types.
steps: Open the Filter dropdown and select a specific action (e.g. 'Approve')
Then select 'All Actions'
test_cases.expected_result: Selecting an action re-fetches filtered entries and resets to page 1; 'All Actions' clears the filter. Filter options derive from loaded entries.

test_cases.title: Audit Log pagination navigates pages
steps: Click Next then Previous; observe page indicator and disabled states
test_cases.expected_result: Page increments/decrements fetch the matching page; Previous disabled on page 1, Next disabled on last page; 'Page X of Y' is accurate.

test_cases.title: Audit Log empty state
test_cases.preconditions: A schedule with no audit entries.
steps: Open audit page for it
test_cases.expected_result: 'No audit log entries found' empty state with history icon.

test_cases.title: Data integrity: planning actions create matching audit entries
test_cases.preconditions: Draft schedule open in another tab.
steps: On the board: add a slot, move it, remove it, then submit
Open the Audit Log for that schedule
test_cases.expected_result: Audit log contains entries for each action (add/move/remove/submit) with correct actor and patient/day details; ordering newest first.

test_cases.title: On-Call Roster loads list (or empty state)
steps: Navigate to /saranam/scheduling/on-call
test_cases.expected_result: Header 'On-Call Roster' with Refresh and Add On-Call buttons; a table of Week/Clinician/Phone/Notes/Actions or an empty state with an Add On-Call CTA.

test_cases.title: Add on-call entry with auto week-end calculation
steps: Click Add On-Call
Pick Week Start Date (week end auto = start+6, disabled field)
Select a clinician, enter phone numbers, add notes
Click Create
test_cases.expected_result: Week End auto-fills to 2026-06-14; Create disabled until week_start + clinician set; entry is created and appears in the table with comma-joined phones.

test_cases.title: Edit an on-call entry
steps: Click the pencil, change clinician/phones/notes, click Update
test_cases.expected_result: Dialog pre-fills existing values; Update saves and the row reflects changes. 404 if the entry no longer exists.

test_cases.title: Delete an on-call entry with confirmation
steps: Click the red trash icon
Confirm the deletion dialog
test_cases.expected_result: On confirm the entry is deleted and the list refreshes without it; cancel keeps it. On error an alert 'Failed to delete on-call entry'.

test_cases.title: Alerts page lists overdue patients sorted by days overdue
test_cases.preconditions: Patients exceeding the visit-gap threshold and not scheduled this week.
steps: Navigate to /saranam/scheduling/alerts
test_cases.expected_result: Header 'Unscheduled Patient Alerts'; an orange count banner 'N patients need attention'; alert cards (sorted most overdue first) showing name, BSC/Onco badges, priority, last-visit days, frequency, cluster, and a days-overdue badge with severity colour.

test_cases.title: Alerts all-clear empty state + Refresh
steps: Open alerts page
Click Refresh
test_cases.expected_result: Green 'All patients are scheduled - no alerts' card shown; Refresh re-fetches. Severity colours: >=14d red, >=7d orange, >=3d yellow.

test_cases.title: Map renders hospital pins, patient markers and per-vehicle routes
test_cases.preconditions: Google Maps key configured; day with GPS patients across two vehicles.
steps: Open the board/active-visits map for a day with multi-vehicle GPS patients
test_cases.expected_result: Hospital pins (K, KC) always render; numbered patient markers per vehicle in distinct colours; coloured road polylines via Directions API with per-leg km/time labels; header total km + drive time; per-vehicle route summary and legend.
test_cases.api_reference: Google Maps JS Directions + patientsApi.getZoneBoundaries (zone overlay)

test_cases.title: Map geocodes address-only patients and flags location-less patients
test_cases.preconditions: Mix of GPS patients, address-only patients, and one with neither GPS nor address.
steps: Open the map for that day
test_cases.expected_result: Address-only patients are geocoded (header shows 'N geocoded from address', marker info window notes 'approx.'); patients with no GPS and no address show 'N without location & address' in red and are excluded from the route.

test_cases.title: Map empty state and missing Google key handling
test_cases.preconditions: A day with no slots; separately an environment without a Maps key.
steps: Open the map for an empty day
Open a day's map when VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY is unset
test_cases.expected_result: Empty day shows 'No patients scheduled' overlay. Without a Maps key the map fails to load and shows 'Loading map...'/blank rather than crashing the page (log as a defect/environment note).

test_cases.title: Unauthenticated access redirects to login
steps: Clear access_token/refresh_token
Navigate to /saranam/scheduling (and a deep route like /board/:id)
test_cases.expected_result: ProtectedRoute redirects to /login; no scheduling data is loaded.

test_cases.title: Expired access token triggers refresh then retry
steps: With an expired access token, perform an action that calls a scheduling API (e.g. open the calendar)
test_cases.expected_result: Axios interceptor catches 401, POSTs /auth/refresh, stores a new access_token and transparently retries the original request; data loads without a visible login redirect.

test_cases.title: Refresh failure logs out to login
test_cases.preconditions: Expired access token AND invalid/expired refresh token.
steps: With both tokens invalid, trigger any scheduling API call
test_cases.expected_result: Refresh fails; access_token/refresh_token/user are cleared from localStorage and the app redirects to /login.

test_cases.title: Any authenticated user can submit and approve (no role separation) - governance check
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as a non-admin clinician user.
steps: Create/open a draft, Submit for Approval, then Approve the same schedule
test_cases.expected_result: Both actions succeed for the same user (no enforced approver role in code). FLAG to client/PM: confirm whether self-approval / role separation must be enforced before go-live; record as a governance finding.

test_cases.title: Scheduling for a past week is permitted by the date picker
steps: New Schedule -> pick a past week start (2026-05-04) -> Create
test_cases.expected_result: Document actual behaviour: the date field has no min so a past week can be entered; verify backend accepts or rejects (ValueError -> 400). If it creates a past-dated schedule, flag whether that is desired.

test_cases.title: Add slot without patient_id rejected
steps: Force an add-slot request with no patient_id (e.g. via API or by submitting an empty modal selection)
test_cases.expected_result: Backend returns 400 'patient_id is required'; UI Add to Schedule stays disabled so the empty case is not normally reachable from the UI.

test_cases.title: Move slot without to_day_id rejected
steps: Force a move request without to_day_id
test_cases.expected_result: Backend returns 400 'to_day_id is required'.

test_cases.title: Create deviation without type/description rejected
steps: In Report Deviation leave type or description empty and try to submit
test_cases.expected_result: Submit button disabled until both set; a forced API call returns 400 'deviation_type and description are required'.

test_cases.title: Empty/no-assignment schedule can be submitted (no hard block)
test_cases.preconditions: A draft schedule with zero slots.
steps: Open the empty draft and click Submit for Approval
test_cases.expected_result: Validation likely returns warnings about empty days but the Submit action is still available; record whether the backend blocks an empty submit (400) or allows it with warnings, and flag if an empty publish should be prevented.

test_cases.title: Approved schedule visits appear in My Visits / Active Visits
test_cases.preconditions: A draft with the test clinician assigned, then approved & activated.
steps: Build a draft assigning the logged-in clinician to slots
Submit -> Approve -> Activate
Open My Visits and Active Visits
test_cases.expected_result: The same patients/days appear under My Visits (for the assigned clinician) and Active Schedule Visits; counts and patient names are consistent with the board.

test_cases.title: Completing a visit reflects in Deviation Report and Review metrics
steps: Mark some visits completed/missed in Active Visits
Open the Deviation Report and (after review-ready) the Review Dashboard
test_cases.expected_result: Completed/missed counts and compliance % in the Deviation Report match the actions taken; Review metrics (completion rate, missed count) are consistent.

test_cases.title: Deviations persist and surface in both Active Visits and Deviation Report
steps: Create a deviation from Active Visits
Reload Active Visits and open the Deviation Report for the same schedule
test_cases.expected_result: The deviation persists and appears in the day's deviation list on Active Visits and under 'Reported Deviations' on the Deviation Report with matching type/description/reporter/time.

test_cases.title: Scheduling a patient removes them from Unscheduled Alerts for that week
test_cases.preconditions: An overdue patient appears on the Alerts page; a schedule for that same week exists.
steps: Note an overdue patient on /alerts
Add that patient to a slot in the schedule for the same week_start
Reopen /alerts (and refresh)
test_cases.expected_result: Once scheduled in that week, the patient no longer appears in the unscheduled alerts list (backend excludes patients with a slot in the week).

test_cases.title: Acknowledgments list reflects clinician acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: An approved schedule acknowledged by the clinician.
steps: Acknowledge from My Visits (SCH-070)
View acknowledgments for that schedule (via API / any UI surface that calls it)
test_cases.expected_result: The acknowledgments endpoint returns the acknowledging user for that schedule; acknowledged state is consistent with My Visits banner being hidden.

test_cases.title: Recalculate priorities runs on board load (background)
steps: Open a draft board and inspect network calls
test_cases.expected_result: A fire-and-forget POST recalculate-priorities is issued on load; priority scores shown on sidebar cards reflect (possibly next-refresh) recalculated values without blocking the UI.

test_cases.title: Add Patient modal lazy-loads the full patient list
steps: Open the Add Patient modal for the first time and inspect network
test_cases.expected_result: The full patient search (up to 500) is fetched only when the modal first opens; the modal initially falls back to the already-loaded pool and is searchable.

test_cases.title: Rapid repeated actions do not corrupt schedule state
steps: Quickly add, move, reorder and remove slots in succession
Observe the saving bar and final reloaded state
test_cases.expected_result: Each action serialises through the saving indicator and a reload; the final board state matches the last successful action with no duplicated/ghost slots.

test_cases.title: Browser back/forward between scheduling screens preserves data
steps: Calendar -> open a board -> browser Back -> Active Visits -> Back
test_cases.expected_result: Each screen reloads its own data cleanly on navigation; no stale data leaks between schedules; tab selection on the calendar is preserved per the URL/state.
